teaser: An infographic studio built to the no-server blueprint, mostly simulated, in a vault: what is real, the business plan, and a bug found live.
core_idea: A working MVP of the no-server blueprint, one HTML file of native web components that draws infographics in the browser, runs in simulation by default, leaves the model's key to the vault host or the user, and carries a business plan for somebody to build, tested by synthetic users and a live check.
